parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Attempt at N2L parallel to the plane — *M1. 4 terms. Allow sign errors, trigonometric-function mix-up; allow $g$ missing.

$T\cos26-8g\sin18-F=8\times0.2$ — A1. Allow with their $F$.

Attempt at resolving perpendicular to the plane — *M1. 3 terms. Allow sign errors, trigonometric-function mix-up; allow $g$ missing.

$R+T\sin26=8g\cos18$ — A1.

Use of $F=0.65R$ to get an equation in $T$ only — DM1. $R$ is a linear combination of a component of $T$ and a component of weight; using equations with no missing terms.

Solve for $T$ — M1. Dependent on all 3 previous M marks.

$T=64(.0)\,\mathrm{N}$ — A1.

Total: 7.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Complete method to find $s$ using constant-acceleration formula(e): $s=\dfrac12\times0.2\times4^2-\dfrac12\times0.2\times3^2$, or $s=\dfrac12(0+0.2\times4)\times4-\dfrac12(0+0.2\times3)\times3$ — M1. Finding distance moved between $t=3$ and $t=4$; must be using $a=0.2$.

Distance $=0.7\,\mathrm{m}$ — A1. If 0 marks scored then SCB1 for $s=\dfrac12\times0.2\times4^2=1.6$.

Total: 2.
